name: Autoimmune Diseases and Loss of Tolerance

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Anti double stranded DNA tracks lupus activity and nephritis
Full house renal immunofluorescence strongly supports lupus
Anti Ro and anti La characterise Sjogren syndrome
Anticentromere means limited sclerosis; anti Scl 70 means diffuse disease
reference.pathophysiology: Defective clearance of apoptotic debris exposes nuclear antigens, driving autoantibody production in genetically susceptible hosts. Immune complexes deposit in vessels and glomeruli, activate complement and recruit inflammation. Chronic injury ends in fibrosis, especially in systemic sclerosis where fibroblast activation dominates.
additionalDifferentials: Lupus nephritis classes and their deposits
additionalInvestigations: Antinuclear antibody titre with specific autoantibody panel
Complement C3 and C4 with urinalysis in lupus
Renal biopsy to classify lupus nephritis before treatment
